fresh_blind_validation_contract.inventory_requirement: A production inventory must be collected after this exact E0.8 freeze is merged to main.
fresh_blind_validation_contract.label_requirement: Reference routing labels must be locked without consulting E0.8 outputs.
fresh_blind_validation_contract.candidate_mutation_policy: Any E0.8 behavior change after freeze invalidates this candidate and is not allowed inside this roadmap cycle.

stop_policy.if_fresh_blind_passes: Proceed to the single final sealed holdout, then final regression/promotion if the holdout passes.
stop_policy.if_fresh_blind_fails: Do not create E0.9 in this roadmap. Close the current evaluator roadmap and make an explicit architecture/product decision instead of further rule tuning.
stop_policy.if_final_holdout_fails: Do not tune against the opened holdout. Close the current evaluator roadmap without promotion and make an explicit architecture/product decision.

methodology.project_objective: Find suitable opportunities reliably while keeping obvious noise manageable.
